method: Shared protocol-15 NetQuake recordings, stationary 360-degree camera sweep at the first deathmatch spawn; one discarded warm-up then five native timedemo passes per engine/map. 800x600 window, FOV90, VSync/MSAA off, uncapped; renderer defaults otherwise. Fresh process each pass; warmed OS/driver caches.

samples.config:
vid_width 800
vid_height 600
vid_fullscreen 0
vid_vsync 0
fov 90
viewsize 100
host_maxfps 0
sys_throttle -1
cl_demoreel 0
cl_discord_presence 0
r_scale 1
vid_fsaa 0
echo FPS_BENCH_qssm_aerowalk_1791317790129846200
vid_width
vid_height
vid_vsync
timedemo fps_aerowalk
